network_card.title: Warm the person, not the whole room
network_card.description: A heated blanket draws a small fraction of the 1,500 watts a space heater pulls. Our sister site compares them on auto-off timers, running cost, washing, and whether they are safe to sleep with.

articles.title: The Best Space Heaters for a Large Room
articles.description: A 1,500-watt ceiling applies to every plug-in heater, so covering a big room is about how the heat moves, not how much there is. The three that do it, and the claim to ignore.

articles.title: The Quietest Space Heaters You Can Buy
articles.description: Noise is the specification almost nobody publishes. The handful of heaters that state a figure or remove the fan entirely, and how to read the silence they promise.

articles.title: What a Space Heater Actually Costs to Run
articles.description: Every figure you have read rests on an assumption about your electricity rate. Here is the arithmetic with ours stated in the open, and the comparison that actually matters.

articles.title: The Best Space Heaters for a Bedroom
articles.description: A bedroom heater has to run for eight hours and be silent doing it. Two requirements that rule out most of the category, and the three that meet both.

articles.title: Ceramic, Infrared or Oil-Filled: Which Heater Type
articles.description: All three draw the same 1,500 watts, so this is a question about the experience you want, not about how much heat you get. Three heaters, one of each.

articles.title: Are Space Heaters Safe to Leave On?
articles.description: Automatic shut-off, tip-over protection and an ETL mark are standard. What each one actually covers, which habits matter more, and when to replace rather than repair.

articles.title: The Best Space Heaters Under $50
articles.description: Below fifty dollars the listings stop publishing anything checkable. Three that still do, and the three questions that separate a bargain from a gamble.

articles.title: Space Heater Timers: Why Yours Shuts Off
articles.description: Some cut out after two hours, some run twelve, a few let you choose. The specification that decides whether a heater suits a desk or a bedroom.

articles.title: The Best Space Heaters for a Home Office
articles.description: An office heater warms one person at one desk, which is a smaller job than most heaters are sold for. The three that do it without roasting the room.

articles.title: The Best Oscillating Space Heaters
articles.description: Oscillation sounds like a gimmick and is the difference between a warm chair and a warm room. The three that do it widely, and what the arc costs you.

articles.title: Will a Space Heater Trip My Breaker?
articles.description: 1,500 watts is about 12.5 amps on a 15-amp circuit. On its own, fine. Sharing with a kettle, not fine. The arithmetic, and what owners actually report.

articles.title: Wall-Mounted and Tall Tower Heaters: When Floor Space Is the Problem
articles.description: A bathroom, a nursery, a narrow hallway — rooms where a heater on the floor is in the way or in reach. The three built to go up rather than across.

articles.title: Space Heater or Turn Up the Thermostat?
articles.description: The honest comparison is not heater versus nothing. It is one warm room versus a warm house, and the answer depends on how many rooms you actually use.

articles.title: Space Heaters With a Real Thermostat (and Why It Matters)
articles.description: Three power settings is not a thermostat. The difference shows up on your bill and in how the room feels at four in the morning.

articles.title: Space Heaters With a Remote Control: Worth the Extra $10?
articles.description: A remote adds a few dollars to the price and lets you change the setting without leaving the couch. What it does not change, and the three that do it well.

articles.title: The Best Space Heaters for a Nursery
articles.description: A nursery heater has to be silent, impossible for a toddler to reach the dial on, and never hot to the touch. The three that meet all three, and the ones we ruled out.

articles.title: The Best Space Heaters for a Garage or Workshop
articles.description: An uninsulated garage loses heat as fast as a heater adds it. The three builds that still make a dent, and why a plug-in heater is not a substitute for insulation.

articles.title: The Best Space Heaters Between $50 and $100
articles.description: Above $50 the thermostats get more precise and the housings get sturdier. Three heaters in this bracket that are worth the jump, and what the next $50 buys.
